raw_output: {"entity0":{"rationale":"Iteration 0 has no race telemetry and no Integrator feedback, so this proposal is a baseline built from the contract's constraints rather than from evidence. Five sensors at 12 mm footprint fit inside the 25 mm tape, so the array can resolve the line position and still give a usable reading when the robot drifts. Spacing of 1 cm across the centre, with the outer pair at ±2 cm, lets the outer sensors see the edge of the tape early and the inner three resolve fine offset. The sensors sit 4 cm ahead of the axle so the steering signal leads the wheels and has time to act. Wheel track 0.12 m and wheel radius 0.03 m give moderate turn authority without excessive yaw inertia. Mass 0.7 kg keeps inertia and slip low, which should help reach the roughly 1.5 m/s average speed needed to finish in 3 s. Body width 0.12 m gives an off-track limit of 0.06 m, the floor value, so the robot is not given extra tolerance it may not need.
